integrity: The Lyapunov identity was independently expanded symbolically and replayed with the bundled dependency-free verifier; the critical endpoint uses LaSalle invariance rather than numerical evidence.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to the uncontrolled, zero-load normalized autonomous PMSM with sigma>0. It does not extend unchanged to input, load, uncertainty, or feedback terms. The closest inspected literature gives local or numerical stability information; an inaccessible or differently parameterized older proof remains a residual originality risk.
title: Closed global-stability boundary for the uncontrolled PMSM model
